property_summary: On a fresh contract, SetMinSum(v) succeeds while uninitialized; when called twice without initialization, the first call always succeeds and sets MinSum to v1, while the second either succeeds setting MinSum to v2 or reverts leaving MinSum at v1, and initialization is not involved.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `SetMinSum(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
